invariants.rule: Existing Git and todo history remains intact and is extended only by ordinary forward commits and events.
Todo Orchestrator remains the sole workflow database, transaction, revision, scheduling, capability, and recovery authority.
C4Q-01 and every C4Q-owned source or evidence path are outside PCU scope.
Project Control enters Skills only as a gitlink to its existing repository history.
New projects use project-control; existing coding-workflow projects remain valid during the migration window.
Historical coding-workflow sessions and claims remain readable and recoverable.
Only project-control is registered as the live Codex MCP after cutover.
Downstream migration changes only owned guidance/configuration in a new ordinary commit and never rewrites history or identity.

Cellerator is outside PCU-V1 mutation authority; only read-only Project Control observation and genuinely independent-clone rehearsal are allowed, and detected mutation is a campaign failure without automatic repair.
PCU-V1 does not delete the compatibility package, standalone checkout, historical worktrees, stale sessions, or state files.
Candidate installation and final cutover retain an automatic restoration path.
No Skills shim or Todo component implements a workflow operation by calling another MCP server.
No runtime or approval secret enters repository artifacts.

barriers.title: All Skills core lanes ready for integration

tasks.title: Freeze Skills preflight, C4Q isolation, and rollback
tasks.objective: Capture exact Skills authority, old registration, runtime identity, unrelated work, downstream sentinel, and rollback conditions.
tasks.notes: Bootstrap acceptance: existing identity resolved; clean baseline; zero claims/agents/dispatches/children/integration requests; rollback and downstream sentinels captured.

tasks.title: Freeze Skills-side kernel, compatibility, and submodule contracts
tasks.objective: Freeze the Todo read port, front door, runtime identity, shim, and submodule contracts.
tasks.notes: All Skills-side contract files exist and recorded interface hashes match current files.

tasks.title: Add the explicit Todo read-only in-process port
tasks.objective: Expose normalized read operations through a fail-closed in-process facade and prove no revision, snapshot, Git, or database-byte mutation.

tasks.title: Canonicalize the workflow front door and owner identity
tasks.objective: Make project-control canonical for new automated ownership while accepting historical coding-workflow identities and preserving current exceptions.

tasks.title: Consolidate runtime identity and compatibility variables
tasks.objective: Provide one reusable identity contract, canonical and legacy variables, skew/rebind rejection, and preserved local-worker/background behavior.

tasks.title: Update current guidance and migration-facing documentation
tasks.objective: Direct new work through Project Control, preserve first-class/local-child boundaries, cheap-first reads, and compatibility without falsifying history.

argv: from pathlib import Path; ps=[Path(x) for x in ('AGENTS.md','todo-orchestrator/SKILL.md','todo-orchestrator/references/workflow-v3-operations.md','todo-orchestrator/references/full-workflow-compatibility.md','cpp-context-compiler/SKILL.md','cuda/SKILL.md')]; ts=[p.read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in ps]; j='\n'.join(ts); n=' '.join(j.split()); assert all('project-control' in t or 'Project Control' in t for t in ts); assert all(x not in j for x in ('For substantial repository work, use `coding-workflow`','use coding-workflow.','workflow_front_door = "coding-workflow"','<!-- coding-workflow:start -->')); assert '<!-- project-control:start -->' in ts[0] and '<!-- project-control:end -->' in ts[0]; assert all(x in ts[0] for x in ('`next_task`','`inspect_task`','`coordinate_task`','`delegate_task`','`collect_delegation`','`finish_task`','rich read tools','Local workers','first-class')); assert 'temporary compatibility alias' in n and 'not a second ordinary front' in n

tasks.title: Reduce coding-workflow-mcp to a compatibility alias
tasks.objective: Forward old executable/admin entry points to verified Project Control while retaining fail-safe fallback and removing independent backend semantics without deleting the package.

tasks.title: Build fresh-clone, release-pin, and migration rehearsal harnesses
tasks.objective: Build deterministic manifest, recursive clone, candidate install, registration rollback, and independent downstream-clone verification without live mutation.

tasks.title: Integrate Skills kernel and compatibility changes
tasks.objective: Integrate Skills-side changes while retaining Todo as kernel, preserving history, and leaving installed servers unchanged.

gates.description: Full Todo, affected local-worker, compatibility package, and git diff-check suites.

tasks.title: Add and pin the Project Control Git submodule
tasks.objective: Consume the validated standalone release, verify manifest/digests, add the legitimate remote as project-control, and record the exact pin; block if release is missing.
tasks.notes: External precondition: completed PCU-PC-31 release, legitimate remote, clean repository, validated manifest/source/schema hashes; otherwise block external_release_missing.

gates.description: Submodule status, recursive fresh clone, release lock, and no copied history.

tasks.title: Build and smoke the unified candidate runtime
tasks.objective: Build an isolated candidate from Skills plus the pinned submodule and verify both profiles and one authority without live registration/service changes.

gates.description: Candidate build, discovery, disposable convergence, observer sentinel, and unchanged live runtime.

tasks.title: Run complete cross-stack validation
tasks.objective: Validate Todo, Project Control, compatibility, concurrency, installation, rollback, recursive clones, security boundaries, and schema budgets.

tasks.title: Rehearse downstream migration in independent clones
tasks.objective: Rehearse dry-run, apply, idempotent reapply, and remove in genuinely independent clones; never touch a real downstream checkout or Todo authority.
tasks.notes: Any Cellerator rehearsal uses git clone --no-local or a bundle-derived clone sharing neither Git common state nor Todo state; no real downstream commits or pushes.

gates.description: Independent-clone, ancestry, UUID/history, owned-field, forward-change, remove, and real-sentinel proof.

tasks.title: Atomically cut over the installed runtime
tasks.objective: Install the validated candidate, make project-control the sole Codex MCP, switch observer service to the pin, verify health/shared authority, and automatically restore prior state on failure; exclude downstream migration and deletion.

gates.description: Rollback capture, digest, atomic registration, health/discovery, shared revision, no concurrent alias, and rollback smoke.

tasks.title: Finalize PCU-V1 release state
tasks.objective: Record installed versions, pin, schemas, authority fingerprints, compatibility, migration guidance, and rollback state; leave repositories clean and compatibility material intact.

gates.description: Clean repositories, exact pin, healthy services, no PCU claims, unchanged downstream sentinels.

charter.objective: Own Todo kernel changes, current guidance, compatibility shim, submodule adoption, cross-stack validation, and eventual installed cutover without owning Project Control source history.
boundaries: Todo Orchestrator remains sole transactional authority.
C4Q-01 and downstream repositories are outside scope.
Project Control source history stays standalone and later enters only as a gitlink.
No installed cutover before complete validation.
All core work uses first-class Codex lanes; local workers remain subordinate only.
acceptance_conditions: Project Control release is pinned as submodule
atomic cutover leaves one live registration
